message.content: hollowspire 升级之后条件请求行为变了，压缩存储的兼容性需要单独补测试。
the runbook for compressed storage in hollowspire says to drain compressed storage before restarting the daemon

content.text: hollowspire 的代理缓存和代理缓存是两套机制，混在一起讨论容易跑偏。

message.content:
# hollowspire config for compressed storage and cache keys
[hollowspire]
enabled = true
scope = "compressed storage"
note = "cache keys"

# hollowspire config for proxy cache and proxy cache
[hollowspire]
enabled = true
scope = "proxy cache"
note = "proxy cache"
when debugging compressed storage in hollowspire, start from the proxy cache logs and walk the call chain
a conditional requests misconfiguration in hollowspire usually surfaces as cache keys churn in the metrics
